covers: the file names are trimmed and stored, and the two diagnostic sections carry the reader's own counters
a decoded-row task can carry a caller-supplied diagnostic set, stored under the same contract
an exact replay keeps the diagnostics of the first admission and does not overwrite them
an unknown diagnostic key is refused before anything is stored
the stored summary, rows, counters, pairing, scope, permissions, generic writes, identity, pagination and deletion from the earlier batches

intentional_differences: the deployed run kept both file names and one diagnostics blob inside a single JSONB row; this platform stores two file-name columns plus a validated diagnostics JSON, so detail can show the names and a later export can read the counters
the store is idempotent per request id, so the diagnostics belong to the first admission of that request; the deployed run wrote a fresh task row per run
only the record keys the deployed readers reported are accepted; an unknown key is refused instead of stored and ignored
a caller may hand over a diagnostics set directly (for rows it decoded itself), which the deployed server-assembled diagnostics never allowed; the structure is still validated
not_run: reading a real workbook, PDF or delimited file, and the OCR paths
asynchronous jobs and polling, the review workbook export that will read these diagnostics, batch delete
frontend integration, deployment, external business results and user acceptance
